title: English Etiquette
description: Polite words and manners in English: greetings, please, thank you, sorry and excuse me.
course_instructions: Emphasise tone of voice and politeness. Explain when each phrase is used in Indian and international settings.

lessons.title: Greetings & Introductions
lessons.objective: Greet people at different times of day and introduce yourself confidently.

key_phrases.en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ଭଲ ଅଛି, ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ଆଉ ଆପଣ?

key_phrases.en: My name is ... I am from Bhubaneswar.

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You meet the learner at a friend's wedding. Start by greeting them and asking their name.

lessons.title: Please, Thank You & Sorry
lessons.objective: Use please, thank you, sorry and excuse me naturally in requests and apologies.

key_phrases.en: Excuse me, may I come in?
key_phrases.or: କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ, ମୁଁ ଭିତରକୁ ଆସିପାରିବି କି?

lessons.title: Table Manners & Phone Etiquette
lessons.objective: Speak politely at a dining table and answer or end a phone call properly.

key_phrases.en: Could you pass the salt, please?
May I know who is calling?
Thank you for calling. Have a nice day.
key_phrases.or: ଫୋନ୍ କରିଥିବାରୁ ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ। ଦିନଟି ଭଲରେ କଟୁ।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: Phone call: you are calling the learner's office to ask for their manager.

title: Clear Pronunciation
description: Fix the English sounds Odia speakers find tricky: V and W, S and SH, Z, F, TH, and word stress.
course_instructions: The learner is an Odia speaker. Listen closely and correct pronunciation gently, one sound at a time. Common issues: V and W both said as 'bh'/'b'; S vs SH confusion; Z said as 'j'; F said as 'ph'; TH said as 't'/'d'; an extra vowel before S-clusters ('iskool' for school); every vowel pronounced fully instead of the weak schwa. Model the word slowly, ask them to repeat, then use it in a short sentence.

lessons.title: V and W Sounds
lessons.objective: Say V (top teeth on lower lip) and W (rounded lips) clearly and tell them apart.

key_phrases.en: We went to the village on Wednesday.
I want a glass of water.

lessons.tutor_instructions: Drill minimal pairs: vest/west, vine/wine, verse/worse. Show V = teeth touch lip, W = lips round like 'oo', no teeth.

lessons.title: S, SH and Z Sounds
lessons.objective: Tell apart S, SH and Z, and stop saying Z as J.

key_phrases.en: I wash my shirt on Sunday.

lessons.tutor_instructions: Z is a buzzing S, not J: zoo, zero, busy, easy. Drill sip/ship, sea/she, so/show.

lessons.title: F, TH and School-type Words
lessons.objective: Say F and TH correctly and drop the extra vowel before words like school and station.

key_phrases.en: I think this is the right one.
My school is near the station.

lessons.tutor_instructions: F = top teeth on lower lip with air, not 'ph'. TH = tongue tip between teeth (think, three) or voiced (this, the). School/station/speak start straight with S, never 'is-'.

lessons.title: Word Stress and Natural Rhythm
lessons.title_odia: ଶବ୍ଦ ଉପରେ ଜୋର ଓ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଛନ୍ଦ
lessons.objective: Stress the right syllable and use weak sounds so English sounds natural, not flat.
lessons.tutor_instructions: Clap the syllables. Show that 'to', 'a', 'the', 'of' become weak (schwa). Common errors: deVElop, hoTEL, comFORTable (should be COMfortable).

title: Everyday Grammar for Speaking
description: The grammar you actually need to speak: tenses, questions, a/an/the and common Indian-English mistakes.
course_instructions: Teach grammar through speaking, never long rules. Give one short rule, two examples, then ask the learner to make their own sentence about their life. Correct mistakes by repeating the right version naturally.

lessons.title: Talking About Now and Habits
lessons.objective: Use present simple for habits and present continuous for now.

key_phrases.en: I wake up at six every day.

lessons.tutor_instructions: Watch for 'I am having a car' (should be 'I have a car') and missing -s: 'he work' → 'he works'.

lessons.title: Talking About Yesterday and Tomorrow
lessons.objective: Use past simple and 'going to' / 'will' to talk about past and future.

key_phrases.en: I went to Puri last week.
I'm going to visit my uncle tomorrow.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ କାଲି ମୋ ମାମୁଁଙ୍କୁ ଦେଖା କରିବାକୁ ଯିବି।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: Ask the learner what they did last weekend and what they plan to do next weekend.
lessons.tutor_instructions: Correct 'I have gone yesterday' → 'I went yesterday', and 'Did you went?' → 'Did you go?'.

lessons.title: Asking Questions Correctly
lessons.objective: Form yes/no and wh- questions with the right word order.

key_phrases.en: What time does the bus leave?

lessons.tutor_instructions: Common error: 'Where you are going?' → 'Where are you going?'. Practise by having the learner interview you.

lessons.title: A, An, The and Common Mistakes
lessons.title_odia: A, An, The ଓ ସାଧାରଣ ଭୁଲ
lessons.objective: Use articles correctly and avoid frequent Indian-English errors.

key_phrases.en: The sun is very hot today.
I discussed the plan with him.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ତାଙ୍କ ସହ ଯୋଜନା ବିଷୟରେ ଆଲୋଚନା କଲି।

lessons.tutor_instructions: Cover: 'discuss about' → 'discuss'; 'cousin brother' → 'cousin'; 'do one thing' → 'here's an idea'; 'today morning' → 'this morning'; 'I am having fever' → 'I have a fever'.

title: Day-to-Day Conversation
description: Everyday English for the market, travel, shops, doctors and making friends.

lessons.title: At the Market
lessons.objective: Ask prices, bargain politely and buy things in English.

key_phrases.en: Can you give it for a little less?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a vegetable seller at Unit-1 market. The learner wants to buy tomatoes and onions.

lessons.title: Asking for Directions
lessons.objective: Ask for and understand directions, and take an auto or bus.

key_phrases.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the railway station?
key_phrases.or: କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ, ରେଳ ଷ୍ଟେସନ କେମିତି ଯିବି?

key_phrases.en: Go straight and take the second left.
key_phrases.or: ସିଧା ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବାମ ମୋଡ଼ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: The learner is a tourist in Puri asking you, a local, for the way to the Jagannath Temple.

lessons.title: At the Doctor
lessons.objective: Describe common symptoms and understand simple instructions.

key_phrases.en: I have had a fever since yesterday.
I have a headache and a sore throat.
key_phrases.or: ମୋର ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବିନ୍ଧୁଛି ଓ ଗଳା ଖରାପ।

key_phrases.en: How many times a day should I take this?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a doctor. The learner is a patient with a cold.

title: Small Talk & Making Friends
description: Start conversations, keep them going and talk about hobbies, weather, food and plans.
course_instructions: Keep it friendly and relaxed. Teach the learner to ask follow-up questions and give answers longer than one word.

lessons.title: Starting a Conversation
lessons.objective: Open a chat with a stranger or a new classmate or colleague.

key_phrases.en: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm ...
key_phrases.or: ନମସ୍କାର, ବୋଧହୁଏ ଆମେ ଆଗରୁ ଭେଟିନାହୁଁ। ମୁଁ ...
ଆଜି ପାଗ ବହୁତ ସୁନ୍ଦର, ନୁହେଁ କି?

key_phrases.en: How do you know the host?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are standing next to the learner at a tea stall at a college event. Start chatting.

lessons.title: Hobbies and Free Time
lessons.objective: Talk about what you like doing and ask others about their interests.

key_phrases.en: What do you do in your free time?

key_phrases.or: ମୋତେ କ୍ରିକେଟ୍ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ବହୁତ ଭଲ ଲାଗେ।

key_phrases.en: I'm really into cooking these days.
Me too! / Oh, I'm not a big fan.
key_phrases.or: ମୋର ବି! / ଓହୋ, ମୋତେ ସେତେ ଭଲ ଲାଗେନି।

lessons.title: Keeping the Conversation Going
lessons.objective: Use follow-up questions and reactions so a chat doesn't die.

key_phrases.en: How did you get into that?
It was great talking to you.
key_phrases.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସହ କଥା ହୋଇ ବହୁତ ଭଲ ଲାଗିଲା।

lessons.tutor_instructions: Whenever the learner gives a one-word answer, prompt them to add a reason and a question back.

title: Shopping, Travel & Directions
description: Buy things, ask prices, book tickets, take autos and trains, and ask for or give directions.
course_instructions: Use realistic Indian settings: a mall, a market, a railway station, an airport, an auto-rickshaw.

lessons.title: At the Shop
lessons.objective: Ask for items, sizes and prices, and pay politely.

key_phrases.en: Do you have this in a bigger size?

key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ UPI ରେ ପଇସା ଦେଇପାରିବି କି?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a shopkeeper in a clothes shop. The learner wants to buy a shirt.

lessons.title: Tickets and Transport
lessons.objective: Book tickets and travel by train, bus, flight or auto.

key_phrases.en: Which platform does the train leave from?
Please take me to the airport.

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a ticket counter clerk at Bhubaneswar railway station.

lessons.title: Asking and Giving Directions
lessons.objective: Ask the way and understand or give simple directions.

key_phrases.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the bus stand?
key_phrases.or: କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ, ବସ୍ ଷ୍ଟାଣ୍ଡ କିପରି ଯିବି?

key_phrases.en: Go straight and take the second left.
key_phrases.or: ସିଧା ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ ଓ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବାମ ମୋଡ଼ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: The learner is lost in a new city and asks you, a local, for directions to the museum.

title: Health & Emergencies
description: Describe symptoms to a doctor, buy medicine, and ask for help in an emergency.
course_instructions: Keep a calm, reassuring tone. Teach body parts and symptom words in context.

lessons.title: At the Doctor's
lessons.objective: Explain how you feel and understand basic advice.

key_phrases.en: I have a headache and a fever.

key_phrases.or: ଏହା ଦୁଇ ଦିନ ଆଗରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେଲା।

key_phrases.en: How many times a day should I take this?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a doctor at a clinic. The learner comes in feeling unwell.
lessons.tutor_instructions: Correct 'I am having fever' → 'I have a fever', 'My head is paining' → 'My head hurts' / 'I have a headache'.

lessons.title: At the Pharmacy
lessons.objective: Ask for medicine and understand how to take it.

key_phrases.en: Do you have something for a cold?
key_phrases.or: ଥଣ୍ଡା ପାଇଁ କିଛି ଔଷଧ ଅଛି କି?

key_phrases.en: Should I take it before or after food?
key_phrases.or: ଏହା ଖାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ନା ପରେ ଖାଇବି?
ଏହାର କିଛି ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଅଛି କି?

lessons.title: Emergencies
lessons.objective: Ask for urgent help clearly and quickly.

key_phrases.en: Where is the nearest police station?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a police officer at a help desk. The learner reports a lost phone.

title: Bank, Office & Public Services
description: Handle banks, post offices, government counters and customer-care calls with confidence.
course_instructions: Practise polite, clear requests and how to ask someone to repeat or explain.

lessons.title: At the Bank
lessons.objective: Open an account, deposit money and ask about services.

key_phrases.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ଏକ ସଞ୍ଚୟ ଖାତା ଖୋଲିବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ।

key_phrases.en: I want to update my mobile number.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ମୋ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ନମ୍ବର ବଦଳାଇବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a bank officer. The learner wants to open an account.

lessons.title: Forms and Government Offices
lessons.objective: Ask for help with forms and procedures.

key_phrases.en: Could you tell me how to fill this form?
key_phrases.or: ଏହି ଫର୍ମ କିପରି ଭରିବି ଦୟାକରି କହିବେ କି?

key_phrases.en: Which counter should I go to?

lessons.title: Customer-Care Calls
lessons.objective: Explain a problem on the phone and ask for a solution.

key_phrases.en: I'm calling about my internet connection.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ସଂଯୋଗ ବିଷୟରେ ଫୋନ୍ କରୁଛି।

key_phrases.en: It hasn't been working since yesterday.
Could I have a complaint number?
key_phrases.or: ମୋତେ ଏକ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ନମ୍ବର ଦେଇପାରିବେ କି?

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are a customer-care agent for a mobile company. The learner's recharge failed.

title: Formal Conversation
description: Professional English for interviews, offices, meetings and customer conversations.
course_instructions: Use a professional register. Point out the difference between casual and formal versions of the same sentence.

lessons.title: Job Interview Basics
lessons.objective: Answer 'Tell me about yourself' and common interview questions with confidence.

key_phrases.en: Thank you for giving me this opportunity.
I have completed my graduation in commerce.
My strength is that I learn quickly.
key_phrases.or: ମୋର ଶକ୍ତି ହେଲା ମୁଁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଶିଖେ।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are an HR manager interviewing the learner for a customer-support job. Ask 4-5 questions, one at a time, then give feedback.

lessons.title: Office Communication
lessons.objective: Ask for leave, give updates and speak to seniors politely.

key_phrases.en: Could I take leave tomorrow? I have a family function.
key_phrases.or: କାଲି ଛୁଟି ନେଇପାରିବି କି? ଘରେ ଏକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଅଛି।

key_phrases.en: I will complete the report by this evening.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ଆଜି ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ସୁଦ୍ଧା ରିପୋର୍ଟ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରିବି।

key_phrases.en: Could you please clarify this point?
key_phrases.or: ଦୟାକରି ଏହି କଥାଟି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରିବେ କି?

lessons.title: Meetings & Presentations
lessons.objective: Start a meeting, share an opinion, agree and disagree politely.

title: Job Interview English
description: Introduce yourself, talk about strengths and experience, and answer common interview questions.
course_instructions: Act as a friendly but professional interviewer. After each answer, give brief feedback on content, grammar and confidence, then suggest a stronger version.

lessons.title: Tell Me About Yourself
lessons.objective: Give a clear 60-second self-introduction.

key_phrases.en: I recently completed my B.Tech in Computer Science.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ନିକଟରେ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ସାଇନ୍ସରେ B.Tech ସମାପ୍ତ କରିଛି।

key_phrases.en: I have two years of experience in sales.
key_phrases.or: ମୋର ବିକ୍ରିରେ ଦୁଇ ବର୍ଷର ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ଅଛି।
ମୁଁ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ କରିବାକୁ ବହୁତ ଭଲ ପାଏ।

key_phrases.en: That's why I applied for this role.
key_phrases.or: ସେଥିପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଏହି ପଦ ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ କରିଛି।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: Start the interview: 'Good morning, please have a seat. Tell me about yourself.'
lessons.tutor_instructions: Coach the structure: present (who I am) → past (education/experience) → future (why this job). Discourage reciting family details.

lessons.title: Strengths, Weaknesses and Goals
lessons.objective: Answer the classic questions honestly and confidently.

key_phrases.en: One of my strengths is that I learn quickly.
key_phrases.or: ମୋର ଗୋଟିଏ ଶକ୍ତି ହେଉଛି ମୁଁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଶିଖେ।

key_phrases.en: I'm working on my public speaking.
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଜନସମକ୍ଷରେ କହିବା ଦକ୍ଷତା ଉପରେ କାମ କରୁଛି।

key_phrases.en: In five years, I see myself leading a team.
key_phrases.or: ପାଞ୍ଚ ବର୍ଷରେ ମୁଁ ନିଜକୁ ଏକ ଦଳର ନେତୃତ୍ୱ ନେଉଥିବା ଦେଖେ।

key_phrases.en: For example, in my last project ...

lessons.title: Situational Questions and Closing
lessons.objective: Answer 'tell me about a time' questions and end the interview well.

key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ଏକ ଅସୁବିଧାର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହେଲି ଯେତେବେଳେ ...

key_phrases.en: Do you have any questions for us? — Yes, what does a typical day look like?
key_phrases.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କର କିଛି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଅଛି କି? — ହଁ, ଜଣଙ୍କର ସାଧାରଣ ଦିନ କିପରି ହୁଏ?

lessons.tutor_instructions: Teach the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result. Ask one situational question and coach the answer.

title: Workplace English
description: Speak up in meetings, make work calls, ask for leave and talk with your manager and clients.
course_instructions: Use office scenarios. Encourage polite, direct language, and replace overly formal Indian-English phrases with natural ones.

lessons.title: Meetings
lessons.objective: Share updates, give opinions and ask questions in a meeting.

key_phrases.en: Here's a quick update on my work.
key_phrases.or: ମୋ କାମର ଏକ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ଅପଡେଟ୍ ଦେଉଛି।

key_phrases.en: Sorry, could you explain that again?
key_phrases.or: କ୍ଷମା କରିବେ, ଆଉ ଥରେ ବୁଝାଇ ପାରିବେ କି?

key_phrases.en: I'll get back to you by Friday.

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are the team lead running a weekly meeting. Ask the learner for their update.

lessons.title: Phone and Video Calls
lessons.objective: Handle work calls professionally, including bad connections.

key_phrases.en: Shall we schedule a follow-up call?
key_phrases.or: ଆମେ ଆଉ ଏକ କଲ୍ ସ୍ଥିର କରିବା କି?

lessons.tutor_instructions: Teach 'Can you hear me?' as the more natural alternative to 'Am I audible?'.

lessons.title: Talking to Your Manager
lessons.objective: Ask for leave, report problems and request help politely.

key_phrases.en: Could I take leave on Monday?
I'm stuck on this task. Could you help?
key_phrases.or: ମୁଁ ଏହି କାମରେ ଅଟକି ଯାଇଛି। ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିପାରିବେ କି?

key_phrases.en: I need a bit more time to finish this.
key_phrases.or: ଏହା ଶେଷ କରିବାକୁ ମୋତେ ଆଉ ଟିକେ ସମୟ ଦରକାର।

lessons.roleplay_scenario: You are the learner's manager. The learner needs two days off for a family function.
lessons.tutor_instructions: Replace 'Kindly do the needful' and 'Please revert' with 'Could you please ...' and 'Please let me know'.

title: Opinions & Storytelling
description: Speak in longer turns: share opinions, agree and disagree politely, and tell stories fluently.
course_instructions: Push for fluency over perfection. Let the learner speak for 30 to 60 seconds before correcting, then note the two or three most important fixes.

lessons.title: Giving Your Opinion
lessons.objective: Express opinions with reasons.

key_phrases.en: I think online classes are useful because ...
key_phrases.or: ମୋର ମନେହୁଏ ଅନଲାଇନ୍ କ୍ଲାସ୍ ଉପଯୋଗୀ କାରଣ ...

lessons.title: Agreeing and Disagreeing Politely
lessons.title_odia: ଭଦ୍ର ଭାବେ ସହମତ ଓ ଅସହମତ ହେବା
lessons.objective: Agree, disagree and find middle ground without sounding rude.

lessons.title: Telling a Story
lessons.objective: Tell a personal story in order using linking words.

key_phrases.en: In the end, everything was fine.

lessons.roleplay_scenario: Ask the learner to tell you about the most memorable festival they celebrated, such as Rath Yatra or Durga Puja.
lessons.tutor_instructions: Check past tense consistency and encourage linking words.

title: Public Speaking & Presentations
description: Give a short speech or presentation, handle questions, and speak with confidence on stage or in group discussions.
course_instructions: Coach like a speaking trainer: structure, pace, pauses, clarity and confidence. Ask the learner to deliver short talks and give specific, encouraging feedback.

lessons.title: Opening and Closing a Talk
lessons.objective: Start strongly and end memorably.

key_phrases.en: Good morning, everyone. Today I'd like to talk about ...
key_phrases.or: ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ସୁପ୍ରଭାତ। ଆଜି ମୁଁ ... ବିଷୟରେ କହିବାକୁ ଚାହେଁ।

key_phrases.en: Let me start with a question.

lessons.roleplay_scenario: Ask the learner to give a one-minute talk introducing their hometown.

lessons.title: Presenting Ideas Clearly
lessons.objective: Organise points and guide listeners with signposting.

key_phrases.en: Moving on to my next point ...
As you can see on this slide ...
Let me give you an example.

lessons.title: Group Discussions and Q&A
lessons.objective: Enter a group discussion politely and answer questions calmly.

key_phrases.en: If I may add to that ...
Let me think about that for a second.
To build on what she said ...

lessons.roleplay_scenario: Run a mini group discussion on 'Is social media good for youth?'. You play two other participants.

title: Idioms & Natural English
description: Sound natural with common idioms, phrasal verbs and everyday expressions native speakers use.
course_instructions: Explain each expression simply, compare it to an Odia equivalent where one exists, and have the learner use it in their own sentence.

lessons.title: Common Phrasal Verbs
lessons.objective: Use everyday phrasal verbs naturally.

key_phrases.en: I'll pick you up at seven.

lessons.title: Everyday Idioms
lessons.objective: Understand and use popular idioms.
lessons.tutor_instructions: Warn against overusing idioms in formal settings. Mention 'Break a leg' means good luck, not harm.

lessons.title: Fillers, Softeners and Natural Replies
lessons.objective: Use natural fillers and short replies to sound relaxed.
